share extension.note: No existing translation; matches the iOS Korean term for share extensions (공유 확장 프로그램 in full).

bottom sheet.note: No existing translation; mostly accessibility text. 하단 시트 is an acceptable descriptive alternative.

tap.note: Verb: 탭하다; imperative UI copy often uses ~을 탭하세요.

toast.note: No existing translation; if a descriptive form is needed in prose, 알림 메시지 works.

passcode.note: Matches Apple's Korean convention (Face ID 및 암호) and existing strings; keep distinct from password = 비밀번호.

jailbroken.note: rooted (Android) = 루팅된; existing string: 탈옥되거나 루팅된 기기.

skin tone.note: Majority rendering; 피부 톤 appears in a couple of strings — prefer 피부색.

server connection.note: UI actions per existing strings: Add a server = 서버 추가, Switch server = 서버 변경.
